summary: Russia launched a massive combined missile and drone strike on Kyiv overnight, killing 12 and injuring over 30, while cruise missiles hit Zhytomyr police headquarters killing two officers. Ukrainian air defenses and tactical aviation intercepted numerous Shahed drones and Kh-101/555 cruise missiles across northern and central regions. A prisoner exchange returned 103 Ukrainian defenders from Russian captivity.
key_points: Russian cruise missiles struck Zhytomyr police headquarters, killing two officers and injuring 20. (Source: @UkraineNow/83553)

Overnight combined attack on Kyiv killed 12, injured 30+, damaged residential buildings, school, children's hospital, and caused industrial fires in Brovary and Boryspil districts. (Source: @UkraineNow/83554)
Ukrainian tactical aviation and air defense shot down 'very many' Shahed drones and cruise missiles during the mass attack. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70683)
103 Ukrainian prisoners of war returned from Russian captivity, including defenders of Mariupol and multiple fronts. (Source: @UkraineNow/83528)
Russian Shahed drones violated Moldovan airspace for 6 minutes over Gagauzia and one crashed in Romania near Grindu, prompting NATO to scramble Spanish F-18s. (Source: @eRadarrua/106297)
Russian drones attacked a border crossing point in Odesa region on the Moldovan border and targeted civilian fuel trucks loaded with food. (Source: @eRadarrua/106299)
Two Russian POWs from the 25th Army escaped from a colony in Petrivske, Kharkiv region, killing a Ukrainian soldier and stealing a weapon and Mercedes. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32589)
Ukraine claims to have disabled 7 of 10 largest Wildberries logistics centers in Moscow region, including Domodedovo warehouse. (Source: @UkraineNow/83540)

sections.executive_summary: Russia conducted a large-scale overnight aerial assault on Kyiv using Shahed drones and Kh-101/555 'Banderyol' cruise missiles, resulting in 12 deaths and over 30 injuries across Solomianskyi, Sviatoshynskyi, and Darnytskyi districts, plus industrial fires in Brovary and Boryspil. Simultaneously, cruise missiles struck the Zhytomyr police headquarters, killing two officers and wounding 20. Ukrainian air defenses, including tactical aviation, intercepted numerous aerial targets across Chernihiv, Poltava, Kyiv, and Zhytomyr regions.

points: Ukrainian tactical aviation and air defense units engaged and destroyed 'very many' Shahed drones and cruise missiles during the mass overnight attack, preventing greater casualties in Kyiv and central regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70683)

A prisoner exchange facilitated the return of 103 Ukrainian defenders from Russian captivity, including personnel from the Armed Forces, State Border Guard Service, and National Guard who fought in Mariupol, Donetsk, Luhansk, Kharkiv, Zaporizhzhia, Kherson, Dnipro, and Sumy directions. (Source: @UkraineNow/83528)

Ukrainian forces reportedly disabled 7 of the 10 largest Wildberries logistics centers in the Moscow region during the overnight drone campaign, including the Domodedovo warehouse, disrupting Russian e-commerce logistics. (Source: @UkraineNow/83540)

President Zelensky awarded the title Hero of Ukraine to Junior Lieutenant Vladyslav Polskyi for rescuing two wounded comrades from a Russian-targeted armored personnel carrier. (Source: @UkraineNow/83551)

An investigation was opened in Odesa after a Territorial Recruitment Center employee allegedly choked a 13-year-old boy during a confrontation; the case is classified as assault carrying up to five years imprisonment. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32566)

Switzerland announced it will cease special protection status for Ukrainian citizens who have not completed mandatory military service starting August 20, aligning with EU plans to exclude such individuals from temporary protection by March 2027. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32578)

Russian forces launched a coordinated overnight strike employing Shahed-type loitering munitions and Kh-101/555 'Banderyol' cruise missiles against Kyiv, Zhytomyr, and multiple central Ukrainian regions, with missiles approaching Zhytomyr from the north at distances of 10-40 km. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70706, @mon1tor_ua/70707, @mon1tor_ua/70708, @kpszsu/73555)

A Russian 'Banderyol' cruise missile struck the Zhytomyr police headquarters building, killing two police officers and injuring 20 people, according to regional administration and Ukrainian leaks channels. (Source: @UkraineNow/83553, @ukr_leaks_eng/32584)

Russian Shahed drones attacked a border crossing point in Odesa region on the Moldovan border; one drone loitered in Moldovan airspace over Gagauzia for six minutes, another crashed in Romania near Grindu, triggering NATO scramble of Spanish F-18 fighters. (Source: @eRadarrua/106297)

Russian drones deliberately targeted civilian logistics in southern Odesa region, destroying two large food-laden truck trailers, indicating a focus on civilian supply chains. (Source: @eRadarrua/106299)

Two Russian servicemen from the 25th Army escaped from a prison colony in Petrivske, Izyum district, Kharkiv region, killing a Ukrainian Armed Forces soldier and seizing his weapon and a Mercedes vehicle. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32589)
Russian 'Rubicon' unit drone operators are reportedly conducting effective strikes against Ukrainian infantry positions, per Russian-aligned leaks channel. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32565)

Russian 'Rubicon' drone unit operators are actively engaging Ukrainian infantry positions in the eastern theater, according to Russian-aligned reporting. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32565)

Multiple Shahed drone groups were detected launching from Russian-occupied areas of Zaporizhzhia and Kherson regions toward northern and western trajectories, indicating sustained aerial pressure on rear logistics. (Source: @eRadarrua/106244, @kpszsu/73566)

Russian cruise missiles approached Zhytomyr from northern trajectories, with monitoring channels tracking 'Banderyol' missiles at 10, 20, and 40 km distances from the city. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70706, @mon1tor_ua/70707, @mon1tor_ua/70708)

Shahed drones from Poltava region moved toward Cherkasy region (Zolotonosha district) and toward Myrhorod, with one drone circling near Myrhorod for extended periods. (Source: @kpszsu/73541, @kpszsu/73530, @eRadarrua/106290, @mon1tor_ua/70718)

sections.threat_assessment: Russia's demonstrated ability to synchronize large-scale Shahed drone swarms with precision cruise missile strikes against both civilian infrastructure (Kyiv residential districts) and high-value symbolic targets (Zhytomyr police HQ) indicates an escalation in terror tactics aimed at maximizing psychological impact and overwhelming air defenses. The simultaneous violation of NATO-adjacent airspace (Moldova/Romania) during the Odesa border crossing attack tests alliance response thresholds and risks inadvertent escalation. Ukrainian air defense saturation appears effective but strained, with tactical aviation playing a critical interception role. The Petrivske POW escape reveals security vulnerabilities in rear-area detention facilities near the front line.
sections.regional_response: NATO's scrambling of Spanish F-18 fighters in response to Russian drone incursions into Romanian and Moldovan airspace demonstrates active alliance air policing readiness but also highlights the risk of direct confrontation. Moldova and Romania face growing pressure to enhance air defense cooperation with Ukraine and NATO. Switzerland's decision to revoke special protection for Ukrainian men of military age not having completed service aligns with EU policy shifts and may increase pressure on Ukraine's mobilization efforts. The Wildberries logistics center claims, if verified, signal an expansion of Ukrainian strike capabilities against Russian economic infrastructure deep in the rear.
sections.intelligence_notes: Allegations against Deputy Head of Presidential Office Iryna Mudraya regarding attempted bail payment for former Energy Minister Galushchenko via shell companies, coupled with her dismissal, suggest intensifying internal political friction and potential corruption scandals that could undermine Western confidence. The Rubicon unit's reported effectiveness against Ukrainian infantry indicates Russian drone operator proficiency is improving. The TCC assault case in Odesa reflects growing societal tension over mobilization methods. DeepState's confirmation of Russian advances near Kalenyky and Tsvetkove corroborates ongoing pressure in the Donetsk sector despite the aerial campaign focus.
